observations.body: Andrew hears, follows, finds Simon, announces what he has found, and brings him to Jesus.
observations.label: Mediation

observations.body: Jesus names Simon as Jonah’s son before speaking the name Cephas and its interpretation, Peter.
observations.label: Identity

observations.body: Following and testimony occur before Simon enters; the new name is the final action of the scene.
observations.label: Sequence

payload.posture: Keep Andrew’s witness, Simon’s existing identity, Jesus’s gaze, and the new name in their narrated order.
payload.tension: Simon receives a future-facing name before the narrative has shown what that name will contain.
payload.title: You shall be called Cephas
